neighbours.label: 'if' introducing a condition attached to an offer or provision ('a copy is included if you would like ...')
fire: A spare key is provided if you lose yours.
Extra blankets are available if the room gets cold.
A second form is attached if you would like to apply.
Free parking is offered if you arrive before nine.
A printed copy can be sent if you prefer paper.
Vegetarian meals are served if requested in advance.
Help is available if anything goes wrong.
A refund is given if the order is late.
quiet: A spare key is provided with every booking.
Extra blankets are available in the closet.
A second form is attached to this letter.
Free parking is offered to all visitors.
A printed copy can be sent by post.
Vegetarian meals are served at every lunch.
Help is available around the clock.
A refund is given within ten days.
